name: JPEG recompression
summary: Repeated lossy saving of one image until blocks, banding and colour noise show.
how: Save the image as JPEG at quality 5 to 15.
Resize it between 50% and 200% and save again; repeat 3 to 10 times.
Raise saturation and contrast, then sharpen, between the saves.
Stop when the subject is still readable at 25% size.

origin.note: The JPEG format becomes the usual lossy image format of the web; repeated saves show visible loss.

adoptions.via: Reddit and Tumblr users recompress pictures on purpose and make the damage the joke.
